caption: The drawing consists of eight rectangular panels arranged in two rows of four. The top row, from left to right, includes: a black background with a repeating pattern of orange-red spoon-like shapes; a pink background with small, scattered, red and white heart shapes; a black background featuring a floral vine pattern with blue leaves and red and white flowers; and a white background with three brown leaf clusters. The bottom row, from left to right, includes: a white background with horizontal brown lines and brown-pink flowers; a green background with repeating yellow-green flower designs and black details; a pale blue and white checkered grid with small pink and blue accents at the intersections; and a brown background with a pattern of red and orange concentric circles and light blue dots. All the panels are bordered by narrow white margins and are placed against a beige background.
title: Figured Material from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
